value.answer: Tomorrow in Denver looks a lot cooler than today. Expect partly sunny skies and a high around 65°F. Rain could move in after 3 pm, about a 30% chance that climbs into the evening. Winds are north-northeast at 6 to 10 mph with gusts up to 17. Lows Tuesday night drop into the low 40s and 30s.
